text:
Sirf TEZ DIMAAG wale
is chor ko pakdenge

Clue isi video
mein hai.
Dhyaan se dekhna!

Nayi dulhan ANJALI
sasuraal ja rahi thi

Apna LAAL gehno ka
dibba CHHUPAYA

Shivam ne coach mein
bas itna bataya...

"Anjali ji ka KUCH
saamaan CHORI
hua hai"

"Main ABHI utha hoon
mujhe kya pata"

Shivam ki nazar se
koi nahi bachta.
